location_subtypes.name: Tavern / Inn
location_subtypes.description: Food, drink and rooms. Tavern and Inn are one subtype. The Bare Minimum Buildings Tavern / Inn is this subtype with 4 spare rooms.

location_subtypes.name: General Smithy
location_subtypes.description: Useful mundane metalwork: basic weapons and armour, tools, repairs, metal fittings and ordinary smithing. Not a specialist Weaponsmith or Armoursmith.

location_subtypes.name: Weaponsmith / Armoursmith
location_subtypes.description: Not a subtype in its own right: an even 1d4 split decides Weaponsmith or Armoursmith.

location_subtypes.name: Magic Store
location_subtypes.description: A specialist dealer in one category of magic item, never every category: its speciality is rolled once.

location_subtypes.name: Jeweller
location_subtypes.description: Jewellery, goldsmithing and precious goods. Trade / Shop labels it Jeweller / Precious Goods, Craft / Workshop Jeweller / Goldsmith.

location_subtypes.name: Builder / Mason
location_subtypes.description: A specialist who can take on major building work.

capabilities.name: Keep upgrades: structural work
capabilities.description: Structural expansion, rooms or wings, walls, towers, gates, fortification, courtyards and major repairs.

capabilities.name: Keep upgrades: mechanisms and complex works
capabilities.description: Defensive mechanisms, hoists, lifts, reinforced gates, machinery, mechanical traps, complex fortification improvements and specialised facilities.

location_subtypes.name: Specialist Artisan
location_subtypes.description: Not a subtype in its own right: the same table is rolled again (and again on every further Specialist Artisan) for what the artisan makes. The location's Quality will be one step higher, once.
